specified_before_results: 2026-11-14; Indonesia results and public competitor descriptions were already seen. The two external rectangles and all tests below were fixed before their data were downloaded or evaluated. This is a follow-up transfer test, not a blind contest benchmark.

regions.name: Punjab study rectangle
regions.selection_reason: Contrasting northern-hemisphere agricultural-burning context; not a claim that every retained hotspot is agricultural.

regions.name: Southeast Australia study rectangle
regions.selection_reason: Contrasting southern-hemisphere region with documented major wildfire episodes; not a classification of every hotspot as wildfire.

inputs: NASA FIRMS annual country files: MODIS 2003–2025, NOAA-20 VIIRS 2019–2025. Retain country-file points inside each exact half-open rectangle; no claim to political-state boundaries.
filters: Aqua only, confidence >=30; NOAA-20 nominal/high. Deduplicate identical observation records, then count occupied EPSG:6933 1 km cells per UTC date. Keep raw filtered NOAA-20 detection count as an intentionally unharmonized comparator.
frozen_transfer: Apply the already-released Indonesia NOAA-20 sector/quarter coefficients unchanged. Existing longitude rule assigns Punjab sector0 and Australia sector2. No seasonal shift, external refitting or post-result changes. This intentionally tests extrapolation outside the fitted geography.
local_model: A separate ratio of summed Aqua to summed NOAA-20 occupied cell-days per calendar quarter. Fit on external-region 2019–2021 only; exclude August and September 2020 because of documented Aqua outage. No fallback for zero training denominator. This is adaptation, not zero-shot transfer. It does not replace the released Indonesia model.
categories: Same-calendar-month Aqua2003–2017 median and p90. At/below median; above median through p90; above p90. Median<=0 means insufficient baseline. Agreement is against Aqua, not all actual fires.
retrospective_support_gate: Aqua and NOAA-20 occupied counts >=20 AND historical Aqua median>=5. This uses the concurrent reference and is only a retrospective diagnostic, not an operational future-VIIRS-only confidence gate. Report all48 months plus gated accuracy and retained fraction; never conceal withheld months.
critical_window: For each audit year, find the consecutive circular3-month window with greatest sum in its12 monthly values; earliest start wins exact ties. Compare startmonth with Aqua using shortest circular month distance. This describes within-year seasonal profiles, not a contiguous dated cross-year event window and not a forecast.
coverage: Available annual files do not prove complete observing coverage; zero rows in a month are zero reported detections, not no fire. Full fire masks/QA for these external regions are not included. Known Aqua outage remains explicit. Missing files must fail the run rather than be filled as zero.
